title: Key West Craft Cocktail Crawl
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges

5 Tasty craft beverages from locally-loved hot spots off the beaten path
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

blurb: Join us on a sip and stroll through Key West's craftiest bars and hidden local gems enjoying 5 local cocktails & 2 food tastings! Discover the iconic stories behind Key West’s signature drinks, like the Hemingway Daiquiri, and explore the sights, sounds, and “intoxicating” flavors of the tiki era, each of it’s 5 stops revealing a new secret. Travel off Duval Street and into neighborhood bars that locals frequent! Sample delectable bites and nibbles between drinks to get a taste of what the island life is all about. Curated with fun-lovers in mind, this upscale bar crawl is ideal for those who are more inclined to mingling and exploring Key West’s vibrant bar scene. Tastings include asian cauliflower bites, taco of your choice, 4 delicious hand crafted cocktails, locally-made beer, and much more. Our group size is limited to 12 people to ensure personal service from the guide.
